actions.action: Trim off mushy, black or dead roots and soft stem sections back to firm tissue
Wash the jar or mug with soap and hot water and rinse
Change the water completely every 3 to 7 days
Let tap water sit out overnight before use
Optionally add 1 drop of 3% hydrogen peroxide per cup of water at each change
Move plant to bright, indirect light near a window
Consider potting in well-draining mix or LECA once roots are healthy
Check for pests if moving it to soil
Watch for firm white roots and new growth over the next few weeks
If stems keep going soft, take a fresh healthy node cutting from the top

reason: The answer correctly identifies root rot from topping off as the main cause and gives the matching fixes of full water changes and trimming rot. It misses the fertilizer and small-container parts of the confirmed fix, and nothing it recommends is harmful.
